messages:
eva: Heads-up 1Q partner ops: we need to run a quick reclass for 6 partners flagged for tier downgrade. This impacts MDF allocation and QBR agendas.

rajan: Which signals triggered flags? is it purely ARR movement or also engagement (integrations)?

eva: Mix: ARR churn >15% qtr, <1 commit in last 60d, and failed SLA during pilot. Full list attached in the doc.

mona: If they move down a tier we need to recalculate MDF commitments pro rata and consider clawback per our policy. I'll need legal/finance to confirm timing. :money_with_wings: 

alex: For QBRs, we should add a "tier review" segment and update scorecards to show a 3-month trend window. That will make decisions less "spiky."

tara: Agree. Suggest scorecard additions: integration velocity (PRs merged), monthly active seats, regional coverage, and NPS from joint customers.

finance-bot: Reminder: MDF clawback policy (v3.1) requires 30-day notice and approved invoice reconciliation before recoupment. See https://finance.internal/mdf-policies.

rajan: Can we avoid full clawbacks by offering a remediation plan? e.g., a performance plan that replaces 50% immediate clawback with a 90-day corrective runway.

mona: That's a good option. Need thresholds defined. Proposal: if partner reaches 60% of target metrics within 90 days, we reduce clawback to 25%. Else full clawback. Will draft policy text.

eva: Also: this quarters QBR slate must prioritize partners with marketplace integrations. We'll fast-track those because they drive the funnel.

alex: Ops checklist for reclass + QBR prep (owners listed). Keep replies short.

```
Reclass & QBR prep checklist
- Export partner metrics (rajan)
- Draft MDF recompute + clawback scenarios (mona)
- Legal review: MSA clauses + notice language (legal -> tara)
- Scorecard template update (alex)
- Remediation offer template & timeline (eva)
- Schedule QBRs + invite partners (rajan -> sales)
- Internal pre-brief (1 day prior) (all)
```

mona: ETA: MDF recompute scenarios by 2070004500. Will include 3 buckets: minor (<$25k), medium ($25k-$75k), major (>$75k).

rajan: ETA: exported metrics and marketplace flag by 2070004420.

tara: Legal will draft notice language and remediation clause by 2070004620.

alex: I'll update the scorecard schema to include trend sparklines and a launch-ready boolean. ETA: 2070004600.

eva: Quick governance question: do we need CRO approval for tier changes?

mona: CRO approval only if MDF change >$50k or if partner is in enterprise tier. Otherwise partner ops + finance OK.

finance-bot: Action logged: "MDF recompute request" created ticket FIN-11234. Please attach supporting ARR forecast.

rajan: Noted. I'll attach ARR forecast and marketplace usage forecast.

eva: Let's run a pilot: pick two partners for an early reclass path and test the remediation workflow before rolling out to the rest. Suggestions?

alex: Recommend one marketplace SI and one channel reseller. Keeps diversity.

mona: Agree. I'll prepare two sample letters (remediation + notice) and we can run them by legal.

tara: Will review sample letters and flag any MSA implications.

eva: OK alls owners acknowledged. If no blockers, we proceed on the timelines above. Post any objections by EOD 2070004380.

rajan: Ack.

mona: Ack.

tara: Ack.

alex: Ack and compiling master doc.

finance-bot: Calendar: "QBR + Tier Review (pilot partners)" scheduled 2070005000 UTC.

eva: Thanks team 1Let's keep comms tight; we'll surface a one-page partner comms plan after legal signoff. :white_check_mark:
